description_en: Reset the password of a Supabase database
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb reset-supabase-project-password --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --account-password Pw123456 --project-id sbp-tyarplz0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetSupabaseProjectPassword

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The password of the database account.

The password must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
Special characters include `! @ # $ % ^ & * ( ) _ + - =`
The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号密码。
由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的任意三种组成。
特殊符号包含：`!@#$%^&*()_+-=`
密码长度为8~32个字符
parameters.name: account_password
